notes: Built the station-visit panel from metrovisitslog.csv (242 visits), merging WMATA monthly exits by station-month-year (Georgetown assigned Foggy Bottom), station-average friendliness (each passerby's highest response category 1-5 flagged in passresp1-5, averaged over all passersby at the station), shuttle and service indicators (walking minutes <= 10). Table 1 summary statistics are matched exactly. Table 2: OLS of panhandlers on these regressors with date fixed effects and SEs clustered by station (fixest). Attempt 1 used fixest's default singleton removal, which dropped single-visit dates (240/98 obs); after comparing with the claimed observation counts, the final run keeps singletons (fixef.rm='none'), giving 242/102 obs. Coefficients are unchanged, and the clustered SEs then match the paper's Table 2 to 3 decimals. Tables 3-4: Brown-Forsythe test (car::leveneTest, center=median) and one-way ANOVA of donations/hour (donations/minutes*60, n=80) and dollars/hour ((cash+inkind)/minutes*60, n=67) across the five stations. All values match the paper.
